title: Auto Loans: rate before discounts when a loan is enrolled in autopay
content:
# Auto Loans: rate before discounts when a loan is enrolled in autopay

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a borrower enrolls an auto loan in autopay from one of their PCB checking accounts. It fixes the starting rate from which the enrolled APR is built.

## Clause

The rate before discounts is the recorded APR on the loan, plus each discount that the loan's recorded list of discounts shows as included in that APR: the product's autopay discount if the list names autopay, and the product's relationship discount if the list names relationship. The recorded discounts, taken together, are counted at no more than the product's discount cap.

## Condition, judgement, outcome

| The recorded list names | Discount added back to the recorded APR |
|---|---|
| neither discount (none) | no discount |
| autopay only | the autopay discount |
| relationship only | the relationship discount |
| both (autopay and relationship) | the two together, limited to the discount cap |

## Worked case (illustrative sizes, not product values)

Illustrative settings: autopay discount 0.20, relationship discount 0.30, discount cap 0.40.

- Recorded APR 6.80, list names relationship only: 6.80 plus 0.30 gives a rate before discounts of 7.10.
- Recorded APR 6.70, list names both: 0.20 plus 0.30 is 0.50, limited to 0.40, so the rate before discounts is 7.10.
- Recorded APR 7.10, list names none: the rate before discounts stays 7.10.

## Points of judgement

**The loan's list still says relationship; is that list what decides the new relationship discount?** No. The list only tells which discounts are already inside the recorded APR, so they can be added back to reach the rate before discounts.
